note: Coordinates from Hirano et al. 2015, Global Change Biology, author manuscript: UF 2.32 S, 113.90 E. That text prints DF as 114.14 E, which is 27 km from UF and contradicts its own statement that the sites lie within 15 km; the burnt site next to DF on the same canal is given as 114.04 E. We use 114.04 E for DF and say so wherever the site is shown.
